query: How do you start over when the life you built stopped working?
why_in_two_sentences: BetterUp offers a generic eight-step list plus reflection questions and a coaching pitch; Dr. Kim Foster offers five mindset strategies with a what-not-to-do section. Ours is the only page explaining why restarts fail: the private blueprint measuring the life survives the move, so the new life fails the same test a year later, and it covers restarts with kids, mortgages, and dependents in 34 FAQs.
what_we_do_that_they_dont: Names the blueprint-versus-life gap as the actual problem, which neither competitor has a concept for
Lays out the only three moves (blame, change conditions, edit the blueprint) and why the first two dominate
Explains why repeat restarts stall at about eighteen months
Covers starting over with kids, a mortgage, and dependents as a first-class section, not an afterthought
34 verbatim FAQs for specific situations: single mothers, dating after a long marriage, restarting with an ex, starting over at 50

above_the_fold.ours: H1 is the query, the short answer gives the gap and the three moves in four sentences, then recognition sentences; the reader gets a diagnosis, not a pep talk.
above_the_fold.theirs: BetterUp opens with a long list of life transitions that might trigger change; inclusive but slow, and the coaching pitch is visible early.

questions_they_answer_that_we_dont: What are the signs it is time to start over?
What should you not do when starting over?
trust_signals: BetterUp shows an author bio and its coaching brand; Dr. Kim Foster writes from firsthand loss as a named MD; ours has no byline or citations.
one_change_with_most_traffic_impact: Add a short signs-it-is-time and common-mistakes block; both competitors carry one, and it catches the reader who is still deciding rather than already committed.
